jdk-jre-jvm--jvm-architecture-in-detail:
1) Class loaders
  String loader: null (bootstrap)
  Main loader:   app
  its parent:    platform
2) Initialization happens lazily
  before touching Config
  [Config] static initializer runs once, on first use
  Config.NAME = app-config
  Config.NAME again = app-config
3) Heap holds objects; stack holds frames
  array of 1000 ints allocated on the heap
  StackOverflowError after many frames: true
4) Threads get their own stack and PC register
  hello from worker-1
